findings.title: Lodging extension for virtual training
findings.fact: Partners are to extend lodging for teams Apr 19-22, 2027, so AmeriCorps NCCC staff can deliver virtual training.

quotes.quote: **Partners to extend lodging for teams Apr 19-22, 2027, so AmeriCorps NCCC staff can deliver virtual training.

findings.title: Eligible Organizations
findings.fact: Qualifying organizations include nonprofit and faith-based organizations, government entities (federal, state, and local), public schools and universities, and Native American tribal councils.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must ensure their organization type is explicitly listed to be eligible for the AmeriCorps NCCC team. If not, they cannot apply.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify that your organization falls into one of the eligible categories before investing time in the application. If you are not eligible, consider partnering with an eligible organization.

quotes.quote: Qualifying organizations include: • Nonprofit and faith-based organizations • Government entities (federal, state, and local) • Public schools and universities • Native American tribal councils

findings.title: Project dates subject to change and include travel time
findings.fact: Project dates are subject to change and include a team's travel time to and from the project.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must be flexible with project scheduling, as dates may shift and the team's travel time is counted within the project period, potentially reducing actual service days.
findings.action_recommendation: Plan for flexibility in your project timeline and account for travel days when estimating the team's available service hours. Maintain open communication with AmeriCorps NCCC to adapt to any date changes.

quotes.quote: *Project dates are subject to change and INCLUDE a team’s travel time to and from the project.

findings.title: Application due date and notification timeline
findings.fact: Applicants must submit a complete application by the due date, and will be notified of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.
findings.business_implication: The bidder must adhere to the application deadline and be prepared for a notification only six weeks before the project start, which may be tight for planning and resource allocation.
findings.action_recommendation: Submit the application well before the due date to avoid missing the deadline. Prepare contingency plans for project logistics, as you may have limited time to finalize arrangements after award notification.

quotes.quote: Follow the instructions to submit a complete application by the due date.
We will notify applicants of award approximately six weeks prior to the project start date.

findings.title: Federal Tort Claims Act Coverage
findings.fact: AmeriCorps NCCC provides coverage for the team through the Federal Tort Claims Act and Federal Employees’ Compensation Act.
findings.business_implication: The bidder is protected from certain liability claims arising from the team's activities, reducing their risk exposure during the project.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the coverage details to understand the scope and any limitations. Ensure that your project activities fall within the covered scope and maintain appropriate insurance for any gaps.

quotes.quote: Coverage for the team through the Federal Tort Claims Act and Federal Employees’ Compensation Act
